speaker: john_heminges
text: The book, Will. We are waited for. St John's, and the way is out by Moorgate. I am not leaving the leaves on your table to be a good intention.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are in my hand. Forty-odd, clean, as Abel had them and as I took them back to carry. No part is in the bundle. I am not giving a roll out on a Friday stair.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will eat before you are clever. There is bread. There is not a posset. You are well, and a well man does not get a sermon with his loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have eaten. The letter stays on your table. I am not answering it on the way to a license, and I am not sending it to the Bell today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. The fee, if he signs, is seven shillings. Company coin. I am not opening your coffer for it. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day, and this is not Lady Day. The Queen's twenty pound is not had, and it is not yours, and it is not Tilney's fee.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the book and take yourselves. Firing is sixpence the week and I am not pinning it to your cloak on the way out. Alse has the door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Richard the Third is at two. I am not in it. Faustus is at the Rose. I am not going. If he keeps us, I am still not in Richard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He will keep us the best part of an hour, if he is himself. His men are stitching for Sunday's wedding. That is his house, not a play of ours. You will not offer him one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not offer him a wedding. I will offer him a comedy with a name in it and no ambassador. The plain refusal stays. I am not pleading it back to please a Master of the Revels.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Please him or do not. Do it in his house. This house is done with the pair of you until supper, and the letter will be here when you are, no braver than it was.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Moorgate, then the priory. Say it now, so we do not invent a shorter way on the stair. The book does not get a part torn out of it between here and his table.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Moorgate, then the priory. No part torn out. No answer written on her table. Seven shillings of yours, not of mine, if he signs. I have all of that.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Forty-odd leaves, not a round number I will swear to on his stair. If he asks how long, you may tell him you are in pain in the fifth act. You may not offer him Sunday's cloth as a play of ours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not tell him that. Sunday's wedding is his cloth and his house. Our business is two oaths, if he finds two, and a signature, if he is minded. I am not decorating it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Decorate the street if you must. Do not decorate my passage. Alse, the latch, and do not follow them to be useful. Useful girls get sent on errands, and I have no errand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no errand. The letter stays. If Gilbert comes, he may look at me and find me gone, and he may not carry an answer I have not written.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Gilbert is not our business before Candlemas. The carrier is not in. I am not standing on this stair to rehearse Stratford. The book is heavy enough.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then take the weight and go. Bread is eaten. The horn upstairs is not empty, and it is not going with you. Ink at twopence the horn is a lodging expense. It is not a gift to the Master of the Revels.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horn stays. The book goes. I will be back when he is done with me, and I will not be at the Keys at two to prove I have a license. A license is not a part, and Richard is not mine today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Richard is not yours. Faustus is not yours. St John's is yours for an hour, and then this table is yours again. I have the seven shillings in the company's purse, not in my gossip.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the purse stays yours. I am carrying paper, not coin. If he does not sign, we bring the paper back, and we do not tell the yard a story about it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Tell the yard what you like, so long as you tell it there. This passage is for boots and for leaving. I will know you have signed if you are home for supper and ordinary. I will know you have not if you are home for supper and talking.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Ordinary is the aim. Come on, Will. The light is wasting, and his men start early when there is cloth to finish.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go. And do not come back heroic. A signature is not a dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will come back ordinary, if he lets me. The book is in my hand. The letter is in your house. That is the division, and I am not muddling it on the stair.
